s: The eighteenth letter of the German alphabet, written in the Latin script.
The eighteenth letter of the German alphabet, written in the Latin script.

Creates pronominal adverbs from prepositions with an initial vowel; in the standard language it is equivalent to her- or hin- depending on the context. This distinction is neglected in colloquial German.
r-.et: From dialectal er-, from her- and/or dar-. Compare Dutch er.

t: Tom spricht den Buchstaben „r“ falsch aus.
Die Spitfire wurde von R. J. Mitchell entworfen.
The Spitfire was invented by RJ Mitchell.
l: Jamal Musiala (r.) ist ein wichtiger Spieler im System von Vincent Kompany.
Kendall (l.) und Kylie Jenner und Kim Kardashian (r.) lassen tief blicken.
